model_organism.citation: Variants in NR6A1 cause a novel oculo vertebral renal syndrome (PMID: 40610405)
phenotypes: Knockdown of either or both zebrafish paralogs (nr6a1a/nr6a1b) causes abnormal eye development (coloboma/microphthalmia-related)
Abnormal kidney development
Abnormal somite development
Phenotypes rescued by wild-type but not variant NR6A1 mRNA, supporting pathogenicity of patient variants

model_organism.citation: Variants in NR6A1 cause a novel oculo-vertebral-renal (OVR) syndrome (PMID: 39606449)
phenotypes: Knockdown of either or both zebrafish NR6A1 paralogs causes abnormal eye development
Abnormal somite development
Rescued by wild-type but not variant NR6A1 mRNA

model_organism.citation: Variants in NR6A1 as a cause for congenital renal, vertebral and uterine anomalies (PMID: 41733738)
phenotypes: CRISPR-Cas9 mutants for nr6a1a and nr6a1b recapitulate human phenotype
Impaired kidney development with pronephros segmentation defects
Adult kidney hypoplasia
Axial skeletal abnormalities
Cloacal anomalies
Disrupted anteroposterior expression of posterior hox genes

model_organism.citation: NR6A1 is essential for neural crest cell specification, formation and survival (PMID: 41611698)
model_organism.knockout_type: full knockout and conditional knockout (temporal deletion)
phenotypes: Loss of function perturbs anterior cranial neural crest cell formation and survival
Complete agenesis of migratory neural crest cells caudal to the first pharyngeal arch
Perturbed NCC specification and epithelial-mesenchymal transition
Persistent expression of pluripotency-associated factors (e.g., Oct4)
Conditional temporal deletion shows Nr6a1 required during mid-late gastrulation
Wnt1-Cre unsuitable for studying NCC specification

model_organism.citation: Revisiting the role of GCNF in embryonic development (PMID: 24029702)
phenotypes: GCNF knockout embryos die around E10.5
Failure to restrict Oct4 expression to primordial germ cells after gastrulation

Impaired cell intercalation in Keller sandwich explants
Abnormal fibronectin distribution

model_organism.citation: The germ cell nuclear factor is required for retinoic acid signaling during Xenopus development (PMID: 12676320)
phenotypes: Morpholino knockdown of xEmGCNF blocks the effect of RA on primary neurogenesis
Derepression of CYP26
Altered hindbrain patterning resembling reduced RA signaling
Reduced RAR gamma expression in presumptive hindbrain

model_organism.citation: Anteroposterior patterning and organogenesis of Xenopus laevis require a correct dose of germ cell nuclear factor (xGCNF) (PMID: 10349627)

Overexpression caused posterior defects and disturbed somite formation

biological.citation: Nr6a1 controls Hox expression dynamics and is a master regulator of vertebrate trunk development (PMID: 36522318)
biological.summary: In mouse, Nr6a1 controls vertebral number and trunk segmentation independently of the tail region. It is needed for timely progression of Hox signatures and for the neural versus mesodermal fate choice in axial progenitors, so changes in Nr6a1 levels may underlie evolutionary changes in axial formulae.

biological.citation: Variants in NR6A1 cause a novel oculo vertebral renal syndrome (PMID: 40610405)
biological.summary: Six rare NR6A1 variants were found by genome sequencing in six families with autosomal dominant oculo-vertebral-renal syndrome (colobomatous microphthalmia, missing vertebrae, kidney anomalies). Zebrafish knockdown of one or both NR6A1 paralogs caused eye, kidney and somite defects. Wild-type but not variant NR6A1 mRNA rescued these defects, supporting pathogenicity.

biological.citation: NR6A1 is essential for neural crest cell specification, formation and survival (PMID: 41611698)
biological.summary: Nr6a1 is expressed in mouse embryos in a pattern that overlaps early neural crest development. Its loss impairs cranial neural crest formation and survival, with agenesis of migratory neural crest caudal to the first pharyngeal arch. Pluripotency factors such as Oct4 persist and EMT and specification are disrupted. Nr6a1 is required during mid-late gastrulation, where it may act as a switch that represses pluripotency factors and activates neural crest specifiers.

biological.citation: NR6A1 regulates lipid metabolism through mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1 in HepG2 cells (PMID: 31315616)
biological.summary: NR6A1 knockdown in HepG2 cells increased lipid accumulation, insulin-induced proliferation and migration, and expression of lipogenic genes (FAS, DGAT2, ME1, MTTP, PEPCK) and CPT1a. These effects ran through mTORC1 (not mTORC2). Knockdown also raised INSR expression and insulin-induced mTOR/AKT phosphorylation, partly via miR-205-5p.

biological.citation: Linear ubiquitination modification of NR6A1 by LUBAC inhibits RIPK3 kinase activity and attenuates apoptosis of vascular smooth muscle cells (PMID: 35543488)
biological.summary: NR6A1 is nuclear and its protein level rises in atherosclerotic rat aorta. It promotes VSMC apoptosis and caspase activity by inducing RIPK3 phosphorylation. LUBAC co-immunoprecipitates with NR6A1 and linearly ubiquitinates it, lowering NR6A1 levels and RIPK3 activity and reducing apoptosis.

biological.citation: NR6A1 couples with cAMP response element binding protein and regulates vascular smooth muscle cell migration (PMID: 26546462)
biological.summary: NR6A1 interacts with CREB, nuclear actin and RNA polymerase II large subunit in VSMCs. It binds the SPP1 promoter via a CRE site and represses SPP1 expression and CRE activity. NR6A1 overexpression inhibits PDGF-induced migration, and adenoviral NR6A1 delivery attenuated stenosis after balloon injury in rats.

biological.citation: Positive expression of NR6A1/CT150 as a predictor of biochemical recurrence-free survival in prostate cancer patients (PMID: 28969082)
biological.summary: NR6A1 protein was positive in 29.7% of 303 prostate cancers and mRNA in 28.1% of 32 cases. Expression correlated with Gleason score and tumor stage and predicted shorter biochemical recurrence-free survival. Knockdown caused G0/G1 arrest and reduced invasion and EMT in DU145 and PC3 cells; overexpression promoted invasion, EMT and tumor growth in vivo.
biological.significance: Gleason P=0.003; stage P=0.042; recurrence univariate P=0.0159, multivariate P=0.0317

biological.citation: Mitofusin 2 Mediates the Protective Effect of NR6A1 Silencing Against Neuronal Injury in Experimental Stroke Models (PMID: 39259438)
biological.summary: NR6A1 increases in neurons in in vivo and in vitro ischemia models. NR6A1 represses MFN2 transcription, and its knockdown reduced mitochondrial dysfunction and ER stress in OGD/R HT-22 cells and reduced infarction in MCAO mice. MFN2 mediated the protective effect of NR6A1 silencing.

biological.citation: Hippocampal NR6A1 impairs CREB-BDNF signaling and leads to the development of depression-like behaviors in mice (PMID: 35183538)
biological.summary: NR6A1 is expressed in the nuclei of mouse brain neurons, and chronic stress raised hippocampal NR6A1 protein. NR6A1 reduced CREB phosphorylation and BDNF, and its overexpression induced depression-like behaviors. Knockdown prevented stress-induced depression-like behavior, an effect that depended on CREB and BDNF.

biological.citation: Extra-germ cell expression of mouse nuclear receptor subfamily 6, group A, member 1 (NR6A1) (PMID: 19164181)
biological.summary: Using an Nr6a1-LacZ knockin reporter, RT-PCR and IHC, Nr6a1 was found in gametes and also in somatic tissues: epididymal sperm, oviduct epithelium, lung bronchioles, brain regions (hippocampus, cortex, cerebellum, thalamus), pituitary, parathyroid and pancreatic islets.
